headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United meltdown edition. Who has been linked?

headline: Robert De Zerbi on Tottenham revival: 'Now we are playing as a team'

headline: Arsenal's Bruno Guimarães on unique penalty technique: 'Not working anymore'
description: Arsenal midfielder Bruno Guimarães has admitted that his penalty technique "is not working anymore," saying that he has to change the way he takes them in an exclusive interview with ESPN Brasil.

headline: Man United's relegation fears grow in loss to Chelsea
description: Manchester United implode in a 2-0 loss against Chelsea, leaving the Red Devils on the edge of the relegation zone as they make it nine games without a win.
